newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury details 95/96 privatisation revenue.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury details 95/96 privatisation revenue.

text.p: The Italian Treasury raised some 12.57 trillion lire through privatisations between July 1995 and June 1996, a parliamentary report said on Thursday.

If you add sell-off income raised by state holding IRI, energy group ENI and holding Consap (which is 100 percent controlled by the Treasury), total privatisation returns during that period were 18.4 trillion lire.
Bonds convertible in INA shares raised a net 3.2 trillion lire, the final sale of shares in bank IMI raised 501 billion lire, while the second tranche sale of ENI stock brought in 8.87 trillion lire.

Over the same period, state holding IRI raised 4.47 trillion lire through sell-offs, the ENI group, which is still controlled by the Treasury, raised 872 billion lire, while Consap made 548 billion lire through the sale of insurance group Nuova Tirrena. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
